label: The guard's memory in files
description: One JSON file per record under <dir>/<collection>/: what a binding of state.port.json delegates to for one process, a laptop, or several processes sharing a volume. It answers the way @storage/store.port.json does, so either meets state.port.json unchanged.

get.description: One record by its key; record absent where there is none.

collection.description: which records: sessions or challenges, each in a folder of its own

dir.description: where the records are kept, relative to the tree or absolute; default .wilanis/auth. Never under a directory the loader reads (X106)

type.description: the shape of the records: @auth/SessionRecord.shape.json or @auth/ChallengeRecord.shape.json

put.description: Write one record whole, under its id, and answer it.

type.description: the shape of the records: @auth/SessionRecord.shape.json or @auth/ChallengeRecord.shape.json

remove.description: Remove one record by its key, and answer it as it was; record absent where there was none.

type.description: the shape of the records: @auth/SessionRecord.shape.json or @auth/ChallengeRecord.shape.json

record.description: the record as it was; absent where there was none

find.description: Every record whose field equals the value. A scan over every file of the collection, and it says so: no read of state.port.json needs it.
